title: Create new subscription services privacy/legal pages
body:
## Description

Requested URLs:

- https://www.mozilla.org/about/legal/terms/subscription-services
- https://www.mozilla.org/privacy/subscription-services

Legal docs content: still to come

The above URLs can "go live" as soon as they are ready.

**Oct 11th:**

Redirect the following URLs to the new pages above:

- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/privacy/mozilla-vpn/
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/privacy/firefox-relay/
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/legal/terms/mozilla-vpn/
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/legal/terms/firefox-relay/

---

#### Success Criteria
- [ ] New legal pages are live in production.
- [ ] Existing Relay/VPN legal pages are redirected to the new pages on Oct 11th.
